status: Design only; unapplied grant manifest. SQL/RBAC/Entra enforcement requires separately authorized live proof.

sqlContainedUsers.bootstrap: Existing approved Entra admin group; never runtime/migrator/pipeline admin. No SQL server directory identity or Graph grant is selected.

migrator.applicationLock: sys.sp_getapplock with Transaction owner and default public database principal; verify actual engine permission/ownership behavior.
migrator.boundary: Time-bound migration grant in a dedicated synthetic-only database whose dbo schema contains only the four application tables. Initial schema SELECT/INSERT lets the unmodified migration read newly created tables; replace those data grants with the listed object grants after creation. ALTER dbo is broad within that schema; no unrelated objects or permanent shared schema data grant. Revoke DDL after the approved migration window.

sqlContainedUsers.creation: Separate reviewed bootstrap using approved object IDs/SIDs; no CREATE USER execution or grants occur in C4. Graph lookup rights are not inferred.

bootstrap: Time-bound approved human for one dedicated RG; separate privileged RBAC/federation administrator. No pipeline Owner/Contributor grant is defined.
migrationExecution: Separate approved human starts the manual job; release/operations have no job-start grant.
operations: Existing approved human group, not a sixth managed identity; no raw logstream, exec, sharedKeys, query-all-tables, SQL data or mutation authority.
